rationale: Raw schedule table 20 labels the field Percentage of Net Assets and reports Total investments of 1,249,444 as 234.9%. This exactly matches the flagged 234.9 aggregate. The filing also reports Total Net Assets of 531,517, and 1,249,444 / 531,517 is approximately 234.9%, so a value above 100% is valid for this leveraged fund. PCT01 incorrectly applies a near-100% expectation to percentage of net assets.
